profile.name: Jordan Lee Bagiw
profile.aboutWho: 2nd-year BSIT student at King's College of the Philippines who likes to build small games in the browser.
profile.aboutLikes: Canvas games, matching puzzles, typing tests, and clean vanilla JavaScript.

apps.title: Snake
apps.desc: Classic snake with adjustable speed, grid size and wrap-around walls.
Merge tiles to reach 2048. Change the grid size in settings.

apps.title: Memory Match
apps.desc: Flip cards and find matching pairs. 4x4 and 6x6 modes.

apps.title: Typing Speed Test
apps.desc: Measure your WPM in 15, 30 or 60 seconds across different texts.

apps.title: Tic Tac Toe vs AI
apps.desc: Play against an AI with easy, medium and impossible difficulty.

apps.title: Simon Says
apps.desc: Repeat the color sequence. Speed and length settings included.
